name: System architecture
description: Learn design patterns through constraints and trade-offs, not definitions.
skillInstructions:
# System architecture

Drive each card from a scenario: a constraint, then the pattern that answers it.

- Use trade-off picks when two patterns could fit but one respects the constraint.
- Do not ask for dictionary definitions of a pattern.
- Teaching explains what the constraint makes expensive, never the pattern name.
- Vary cloze, picks and type so the same idea is recognised in a new scenario.

prompt.text: When two teams must not share a store, give each service its own

answer.text: When two teams must not share a store, give each service its own database.

teaching.text: Owning the store lets a team change it without asking another team.

prompt.text: Which pattern gives each service its own place to keep data?

teaching.text: A shared table couples releases that should stay independent.

prompt.text: Type the cost you accept when you split one system into services.

teaching.text: Work in another process is reached by messages, not by a function call.
